messages.content: Find out the rewards for playing Fortnite on Playstation platform with different missions and trophies

function.name: game_scores_get
function.description: Retrieve scores and rankings based on player’s performance in a certain game. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

platform.description: The gaming platform e.g. Xbox, Playstation, PC

level.description: The level of the game for which you want to retrieve the scores.

player.description: The name of the player for whom you want to retrieve scores. Default ''

function.name: game_rewards_get
function.description: Retrieve information about different types of rewards that you can receive when playing a certain game. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

platform.description: The gaming platform e.g. Xbox, Playstation, PC

mission.description: The mission for which you want to know the rewards. Default to ''

trophy.description: The trophy level for which you want to know the rewards. Default to ''

function.name: game_missions_list
function.description: List all missions for a certain game. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.reasoning:
We need to call game_rewards_get twice? Actually we need to find out rewards for playing Fortnite on Playstation platform with different missions and trophies. We could list all missions first then get rewards per mission or trophy. But question: "Find out the rewards for playing Fortnite on Playstation platform with different missions and trophies". Likely they want to retrieve rewards for each mission and trophy. So we should call game_missions_list to get missions, then for each mission call game_rewards_get with mission param. Also maybe call game_rewards_get with trophy param. Let's do both.

First call game_missions_list(game="Fortnite"). Then for each mission, call game_rewards_get(game="Fortnite", platform="Playstation", mission=mission). Also call game_rewards_get(game="Fortnite", platform="Playstation", trophy=trophy) for each trophy. But we don't have trophy list. Maybe we can just call with default trophy ''? But better to ask for trophy list? There's no function for listing trophies. So maybe just call with trophy='' to get general rewards? But question says "different missions and trophies". So we might call with mission='' and trophy='Bronze', 'Silver', etc. But unknown trophy names. Could guess common ones: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum. Let's call with trophy='Bronze', 'Silver', 'Gold', 'Platinum'.

Thus we will call game_rewards_get for each mission and each trophy. We'll produce separate calls.
